summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated sibling payload
details: @or-sdk/billing@27.2.3 declares scripts.preinstall pointing at setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/ into a temp directory (or uses a preexisting system bun) and then invokes it via execFileSync(bunBinary, [join(D, 'math_init.js')]) against a sibling file math_init.js. The sibling math_init.js is a 727KB bundle (sha256 9fc2570b7cef51c1b8df116d144d11ff4096357be7d2c4c6367cfc2509cf1bcc) marked '// @bun @bun-cjs' and constructed with obfuscator.io-style techniques (a large mixed numeric/string constant table n7gIxM plus a rotator function WV8StW that shifts the array to reconstruct strings and opcodes at runtime), so its network, filesystem, and credential-touching behavior is not inspectable prior to execution. The package's advertised purpose is a Billing SDK, which does not require pulling a second language runtime at install time to execute an opaque 727KB payload named math_init.js. Running the payload under Bun rather than Node also causes it to execute outside the visibility of Node-based supply-chain tooling. This is the alternate-runtime-dropper install-time-RCE shape: an unaudited, purpose-mismatched, heavily obfuscated blob is executed automatically on every `npm install` of the package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
